no21-24mar1807.summary: George W. Erving, US chargé at Madrid, to Secretary of State Madison, 24 March 1807, in Pinckney's legation code: the Prussian chargé reports a secret meeting with the Prince of the Peace, who says Bonaparte offered him the Electorate of Hanover and dreams of exchanging it for Gibraltar; Erving reads the offer as a French move to weaken Spain and bind the Prince to France. Madison's interlinear decode is the reading; the project closed its holes.

snip.cap: M31 reel 12, frame 0285: Erving’s code groups with Madison’s interlinear decode, “having Ha—er” and “exchange Hanover for Giblartar”

system: Numerical word-and-syllable code of the Madrid legation (Pinckney's code; the = 1651, of = 133), groups joined by dots.
